PROFILE::webacceleration
       Returns the value of an web acceleration profile setting.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::webacceleration ATTR

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the value of an web acceleration profile setting

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the value of an web acceleration profile setting

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
